scope: Narrow reference print poses and removable structural supports. Physical printing, removal, fit and strength remain unmeasured.

source.title: PrusaSlicer 2.9 support material
source.basis: Per-object support settings, build-plate-only supports and bridge support. These settings are engineering print targets, not a physical strength or removal guarantee. Actual delivered projects must pass slicing, settings, source-mesh and bed checks.

removal: Remove all temporary supports and brims before assembly or weighing. Inspect bearing faces, bores, contact guides and every wire/lacing channel. Do not cut retaining lips, thin walls or integrated fixtures. Stop if features are incomplete or damaged. Qualify removal and fit on the samples before ordering full parts.
optical_rings: Keep both optical rings and their samples upright and support-free, with the unchanged shared optical-material profiles.
